trap.label: modal
trap.wrong: You should to call your mother.
trap.why: O brasileiro acrescenta to depois de should. Compare: should (geral), ought to (moral), had better (urgência com consequência).

mcq.q: Aviso urgente: “You **___** take an umbrella, or you’ll get wet.”

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com had better: “You should wear a coat.”
rewrite.answer: You had better wear a coat.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com ought to: “You should be kind.”
Negativa com had better: “You had better lie.”
